answer: Give every account one copper token, cast once per person and stamped with a unique ripple pattern no mint can repeat cheaply. Each month its owner hands it to a different real person, who stamps the next ripple into the soft metal and logs the handoff beside a velvet cloth of that month's color. A Sybil farm would need a separate token, a separate chain of real handoffs, and a separate velvet witness for every identity, so faking hundreds of accounts means forging hundreds of tokens and staging hundreds of meetings, while any token that stops moving soon goes stale and exposes the fraud.
